title: Energy Storage Comparison Table config
description: Editor-supplied configuration for the energy-storage-comparison-table widget. Every field is optional; widget falls back to documented defaults.

title.description: Visible <h3> heading at the top of the widget.

subtitle.description:
Visible

subtitle directly below the heading.
subtitle.default: How each energy storage technology compares to lithium-ion at its peak suitability duration.

peakSuitability.description: Duration band where this technology is most cost-effective.

liIonCost.description: Lithium-ion cost at the same duration.

techCost.description: This technology's cost at its peak suitability duration.

vsLiIon.description: Cost ratio vs. lithium-ion at the same duration.

keyAdvantage.description: Free-text summary of the technology's key advantage at this duration.
